grouping_rule: fuel | nominal pressure band (nearest of [0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0] atm) | diluent | O2, CO2 and He mole fractions to 0.01; fixed from conditions before any target was read

candidates.global_median: median K of the training fold
candidates.fuel_median: median K of the training fold for the same fuel, else the global median
candidates.ridge: standardised ridge on the seven allowed inputs; alpha from {0.1, 1, 10} by inner grouped CV
candidates.ridge_phys: ridge on physics-informed inputs (ln p, fuel interactions); alpha by inner grouped CV
candidates.extra_trees: 300 extremely randomised trees, min 3 rows per leaf; evaluated, not exported (size)
candidates.selected: nested: inside each outer fold, ridge or ridge_phys is chosen by inner grouped CV on the training rows only

limits: Out-of-fold errors are for unseen regimes of the same two fuels in the same facility; they say nothing about other fuels, gravity or forced flow.
The candidate families were fixed after a first exploratory run that also tried gradient boosting; no number on the page comes from that run.
K is read as mm²/s from a header that says mm.
